what_worked: Asked for the R/T table instead of using a recalled B value; skills loaded before the first tool call.
optimize_fit multistart reproduced the truth coefficients; GUM with the fit correlation matrix gave u(T) = 0.0025 K.
Explained why the datasheet tolerance and not the fit CI is the number to report, and how to shrink it (measure R25 of the actual part).
One optimisation per fin count gave the correct integer optimum; thermal_fin array result used as an independent check.
